{"reason":"Change the medium/high fallback from suggest-alternative-supplier to alert-planner. The 34 train supplier switches each cost 45,000 versus 35,000, while alert-planner always arrives in time. Thus this single action change should reduce cost from 2,165,000 and eliminate the four train stockouts, satisfying the business gate.","source":"(define (expedite-response risk-level inventory-days)
  (cond
    ((and (>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'high))
          (< inventory-days 5))
      (list 'alert-planner 'immediate-expedite-review))
    ((>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'medium))
      (list 'alert-planner 'immediate-expedite-review))
    (else (list 'monitor))))"}
